I'm not sure this is for me. It has an interesting take on planning, and project management. However, it uses some fancy terminology, like “endeavors” and similar posh terms, which I find I always have to stop, pause a second, translate internally inside my head, and then understand what I'm trying to do. This introduces sufficient friction that it makes the whole process difficult for me. Maybe it's good for somebody else. Just not for me.

If there was a way for example to replace “endeavors” with “projects”, etc. Simpler, easier to grasp terms, I can see how this could become a nice method of streamlining conception, planning, execution, and retrospective review of a lot of things.
